copy.headline: Suspect arrested after alleged shooting, pursuit involving DPS trooper in downtown San Antonio
copy.caption: A Texas DPS trooper discharged a weapon while pursuing a suspect who allegedly fired at a victim in downtown San Antonio early Friday, police said.
